turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! Please send your order number and the email address you used at checkout so I can check your delivery status and tracking link.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
I can’t look up an order by name alone. To check your delivery status and share the tracking link, I’ll need the order number and the email address used at checkout.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share the delivery address or confirm whether it has shipped without verifying the order number and the email address used at checkout.
